notes: §1985:XIII.3.17.3 SR3: "When the SIGN clause is included in a report group description entry, the SEPARATE CHARACTER phrase must be specified." DataBinder.ScreenReportSignClauses runs below DialectLevel 2002 over every written report group entry and refuses a SIGN clause with no SEPARATE through the report-sign-without-separate-2002 construct (COBOL0900, 'requires COBOL-2002'; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 123 dropped the requirement), once per written entry. Probes at 85 (work-slice-54/c9*, c10*; classes b, c, d): SIGN TRAILING, SIGN IS LEADING and SIGN LEADING on an unsigned PIC 9(3) each print COBOL0900 (the last also COBOL2422 for SR1); LEADING SEPARATE without the optional SIGN IS words, SIGN TRAILING SEPARATE CHARACTER and an S9(3) entry with no SIGN clause run. The witness (PIC S9(3) SOURCE WS-NUM SIGN LEADING) is refused with COBOL0900.

next.reason: 1985: "When the SIGN clause is included in a report group description entry, the SEPARATE CHARACTER phrase must be specified."; 2023: "SR-13.18.52.3-1 allows SIGN in 'a numeric report group description entry whose picture...contains the symbol 'S'' with no SEPARATE requirement". 2023 SIGN rules still allow SIGN in report group entries, and the format leaves SEPARATE optional. No candidate requires SEPARATE CHARACTER there, so the 1985 requirement is dropped.
